findings.title: include_website_name is missing the trailing '?', so it is never called
findings.body: ActiveModel::Serializers only honors `include_<attr>?` hooks. Without the `?`, this method is dead code and website_name is always emitted, even when the website is blank. It is also not covered by untrusted_attributes, so anonymous viewers of a TL0 user's profile get website_name (the host/path of the hidden website) even though `website` is hidden. That leaks information the restriction was meant to hide.

findings.title: `"." << website_host` mutates a string literal, and the suffix check is wrong
findings.body: `"..." << website_host` appends in place to the literal. With frozen string literals this raises FrozenError, and otherwise it is fragile. The `ends_with?("." + website_host)` logic here also misfires when the website host has a different label count, for example a website of a.example.com on an instance of forum.example.com.

findings.title: Path appended without normalization; invalid URI handling is fragile
findings.body: `URI(website.to_s).path` is appended unchanged. A website like `http://example.com/` yields `example.com/`, and a path-only value with no host returns nil. The URI is parsed repeatedly, and `rescue nil` swallows every error. Parse once and strip trailing slashes. Also, if current_hostname is nil, the `.split` calls raise.

findings.title: Missing test coverage for sibling-subdomain and blank-website cases
findings.body: The tests do not cover the sibling-subdomain branch (www.example.com against forum.example.com), a blank website, or an invalid URL. They also do not verify that website_name is omitted for the anonymous TL0 user. The missing `?` on include_website_name would have been caught by such tests.
